environment.description: Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer). The NLB target group has client IP preservation disabled (proxy protocol v2 not enabled). Upstream connectivity is provided exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint (vpce-0a3f8e2d) in the consumer VPC. The consumer VPC's route table (rtb-04ae91bc) has no internet gateway or NAT gateway routes — only local VPC CIDR 10.200.0.0/16 and the PrivateLink ENI prefix list (pl-63a5400a). The NLB security group (sg-0f2c8819a) allows inbound TCP/443 only from source CIDR 10.200.16.0/21 (the consumer application subnet). DNS resolution for the service endpoint is handled via Route53 private hosted zone associated only with the consumer VPC. The ECS task security group (sg-0d4e7712b) allows inbound only from the NLB security group on port 5000. There is no public IP assignment on the Fargate task ENI, and the subnet route table has no 0.0.0.0/0 route.

config.ecs_task_sg: sg-0d4e7712b, inbound TCP/5000 from sg-0f2c8819a only
config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone, consumer VPC association only
